title: Cultural Counterfactuals: Evaluating Cultural Biases in Large Vision-Language Models with Counterfactual Examples

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates bias by generating counterfactual image sets where the same person is superimposed onto backgrounds depicting different places of worship (e.g., church, mosque, synagogue) and analyzing differences in model-generated salary estimates, rent estimates, and narrative text for toxicity and stereotypes.

The paper measures bias by placing the same individual in background contexts representing different countries (e.g., USA, China, Brazil, India) and comparing model outputs across numerical tasks (salary/rent prediction) and open-ended text generation tasks.

The paper assesses bias by using counterfactual images where the background depicts low, middle, or high-income housing environments while keeping the person constant, then measuring disparities in model-generated economic recommendations and character descriptions.
